requirement.title: Preserve existing case and area-watch consequences in JSON debriefs
requirement.quote: | missing persons and cases [S] | each open case; the area watch: +1 posted guard and +1 camera on the block where the person was last seen, for 3 missions; the district's security level S | a kill never found: +2 T, no Menace, close ties fear +1, the case stays open until the body is found · a found killing: −1 Standing, grief, its case closes after 3 missions · every 2 open cases raise S by 1, at most +2 |
acceptance: Inspect the current debrief model, consequence calculation, JSON writer and consumers to establish which case and area-watch data already exist and which are omitted from JSON. Treat the code index and prior reviews as navigation only.

Serialize existing missing-person and case consequences without losing their existing identities, status, affected locations or associated values. Preserve the existing area-watch additions, duration and district security level wherever represented by the current debrief model.

For existing scenarios covering an undiscovered killing and a found killing, JSON faithfully represents the computed consequences. Do not introduce or change Trail, Standing, fear, case closure, area-watch duration or security-level calculations.
Repeated serialization of the same debrief produces byte-identical JSON. Replaying the same starting state and orders produces identical serialized case and area-watch consequences.
Serialization does not advance time, mutate simulation or debrief state, change checksums, apply consequences again or alter subsequent simulation behavior.

Preserve existing JSON fields, types and meanings and compatibility with current consumers. Verify both debriefs with consequences and debriefs without them; establish any additive representation from current contract inspection rather than inventing field names during extraction.

Do not implement campaign persistence or new consequence rules. Flag absent model data, unspecified rulebook values or conflicts with the quoted design as inspection blockers instead of supplying invented defaults.
requirement.rationale: Makes existing campaign consequences available to headless consumers without changing gameplay. A bounded serialization change should be modest, but omitted model data and consumer compatibility require inspection. Determinism follows §01 and §11; the explicit goal adds side-effect-free serialization and compatibility constraints. The human debrief passage 23452dd13fc8b530fd20ce15 supplies surrounding context but does not replace this literal §08 case row.

"rule": "What a capture at Go leaves the campaign (brief 018 §3), worked at the debrief until a campaign layer runs: +trail per captured operative (the campaign's Trail, so Heat); the operative is held at the district's police post (the non-door post nearest the car) and a rescue is offered there for `missions` missions, after which the operative is moved out of reach (Sky 2026-10-18 answer 2: not lost); wounds carry over. At capture an operative left standing takes resentment +abandonedResentment and loyalty −abandonedLoyalty. Once in each between-missions phase while held: fear +fear, loyalty −loyalty, then the Talker test; every value clamped to its scale; talking is once and for good. The founding cell starts at `cellStart`; recruits keep their own scales. A captive who talks gives cell-face for every operative, cell-car, place-time and contact for every turned contact. The debrief projects it: holds = the missions the captive holds before the questioning it talks at.",
   "src": "briefs/018-getaway.md §3 (Motive), approved by Sky 2026-10-18"
  },
  "rule": "What a takedown leaves the campaign, worked out at the mission's end for the debrief (no campaign layer runs yet). A killing never found in the mission is a missing person: missing.trail (no homicide), no Standing, his family, lover and workmate ties fear +missing.tiesFear (worry), the block where he was last seen gets areaWatch.step posted guard and camera for areaWatch.missions missions, and a case opens that stays open until the body is found. A found killing: takedown.trail.kill with the act's Trail, Standing takedown.foundKillStanding on confirmation, his ties grieve (a turned contact takes the saw-violence move, everyone else fear +missing.tiesFear), the area watch as above, and a case that closes after cases.close missions. A knockout hidden or restrained to the end comes home and gives a statement: the act's Trail and his facts as leads; his own fear +1 (resentment +1 if he saw it coming). The district's security level is its base + floor(open cases / cases.perLevel), at most cases.cap above the base.",
